description: Lightweight native Windows screenshot and annotation tool: tray-resident, ~1 MB single exe, built in Rust.
notes: AirSnip runs elevated (its exe manifest requires administrator), so a UAC prompt appears on every launch.
Its built-in updater overwrites the exe in place, which conflicts with Scoop version tracking.
Disable it via tray icon -> Settings -> About -> auto check update.
Settings live in `%APPDATA%\airsnip\config.toml`, not in the install dir.
